title: Dynamic Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing with Online Requests: Event-Driven Transformer--DRL and Rolling-Horizon Benchmarking
abstract: arXiv:2608.13799v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents an event-driven learning and benchmarking framework for the Dynamic Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing Problem with progressively revealed requests and evolving vehicle states. Masked MLP and Transformer policies are trained through behavior cloning and proximal policy optimization. Deterministic feasibility masking prevents invalid vehicle--request assignments, while fixed-prefix/flexible-suffix route commitments protect completed, active, and near-term decisions and separately measure vehicle reassignment and resequencing. The learned policies are compared with dynamic insertion heuristics and time-limited rolling-horizon optimization. In a 20-scenario policy benchmark, all methods completed every request without invalid actions, but nearest feasible achieved the lowest mean objective and outperformed the learned policies in routing quality, waiting time, stability, makespan, and runtime. translated_title: 动态多车场车辆路径问题与在线请求：事件驱动Transformer--DRL与滚动时域基准测试
translated_abstract: 本文针对动态多车场车辆路径问题（Dynamic Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing Problem）提出了一种事件驱动的学习与基准测试框架，该问题具有逐步揭示的请求和不断演变的车辆状态。通过行为克隆和近端策略优化（PPO）训练了掩码多层感知机（MLP）和Transformer策略。确定性可行性掩码防止了无效的车辆-请求分配，而固定前缀/灵活后缀的路线承诺保护了已完成、进行中及近期决策，并分别衡量车辆重新分配和重新排序。学习策略与动态插入启发式算法以及限时滚动时域优化进行了比较。在20个场景的策略基准测试中，所有方法均完成了每个请求且无无效操作，但最近可行（nearest feasible）方法实现了最低的平均目标值，并在路线质量、等待时间、稳定性、完工时间和运行时间方面优于学习策略。在五次独立训练中，结果保持一致。
tldr: 本文提出事件驱动Transformer-DRL框架解决动态多车场车辆路径问题，但实验表明简单最近可行启发式算法在路由质量和稳定性上优于学习策略，凸显了启发式方法的竞争力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an event-driven Transformer-DRL framework for dynamic multi-depot vehicle routing, yet experiments show that a simple nearest-feasible heuristic outperforms learned policies in routing quality and stability, highlighting the competitiveness of heuristics.
